meaning.en: Relating to or marked by sthenia; strong, vigorous, or active.
meaning.vi: Liên quan đến hoặc được đánh dấu bởi chứng suy nhược; mạnh mẽ, hoạt bát hoặc năng động.

sentences.en: Conclusion The occurrence and the progress of elderly asthma are related to the immunological function disorder, which embodies in sthenic humoral immune function and cellular immune function.

sentences.en: These plants contain various chemical constituents and have broad bioactivities such as sthenic, anti-tumor, analgesic and anti-inflammatory and should be further investigated.
